plain_english_summary: Deterministic trajectory compression and maneuver search for geospatial telemetry and movement traces.
commercial_wedge: Store and search large movement traces economically. Maneuver-aware search on compressed fleet routes, vessel tracks, and logistics traces with H3 spatial indexing.
technical_wedge: Deterministic geospatial encoding using 8-compass direction primitives with magnitude quantisation and RLE, plus H3 roundtrip validation, maneuver search indexing, and trajectory fidelity checks.
ideal_first_buyer: Mobility analytics platform or fleet telematics team
deployment_model: SDK — Python package with H3 spatial backend
family_position: Product candidate in the Zer0pa deterministic encoding family. ZPE-IMC is the umbrella integration layer.
